chain_link.note: The second entry commits to the first through prev.

merkle_root.rfc6962_reference_note: RFC 6962 reference tree over the standard test leaves (raw bytes, hex): "", 00, 10, 2021, 3031, 40414243, 5051525354555657, 606162636465666768696a6b6c6d6e6f. Entry n is the root over the first n leaves. Values 3 to 6 were corrected in v1.6.0: the earlier file carried roots that neither verify.php nor the RFC produces, and nothing had checked them.

checkpoint_signature.note: Ed25519 over the raw 32 bytes of checkpoint_hash, under the published test key.

ed25519_acceptance.note: libsodium is normative for Ed25519 acceptance (verify.php verifies through sodium_crypto_sign_verify_detached). Each case was checked against libsodium 1.0.22. A stock RFC 8032 verifier accepts several of the rejected cases; an implementation must reject every case marked reject. Messages are raw 32-byte checkpoint hashes; all values are hex.

cases.name: genuine
cases.note: the corpus checkpoint signature under the published test key

cases.name: small-order-r
cases.note: R is the identity point (order 1); the verification equation holds, libsodium rejects small-order R

cases.name: small-order-public-key
cases.note: the public key is the identity point; S*B = R + k*A holds for every message, libsodium rejects small-order public keys

cases.name: non-canonical-public-key
cases.note: the public key's y coordinate is p+1, a non-canonical encoding of the identity; libsodium rejects non-canonical public keys

cases.name: order-8-public-key-26e8958f
cases.note: the public key has order 8 and the signature was forged without any private key (k*A vanishes when k is a multiple of 8); libsodium rejects small-order public keys

cases.name: order-8-public-key-c7176a70
cases.note: the public key has order 8 and the signature was forged without any private key (k*A vanishes when k is a multiple of 8); libsodium rejects small-order public keys

cases.name: non-canonical-s
cases.note: S is the genuine scalar plus the group order; both libsodium and RFC 8032 reject S >= l

cases.name: wrong-message
cases.note: a genuine signature over a different message

json_parsing.note: Whether a document parses, and what it canonicalises to, as PHP's json_decode in object mode and verify.php's canonical_encode decide it under PHP 8.4.25. Inputs and canonical forms are base64 because several are not valid UTF-8 or contain control characters. verdict is ok or invalid; type is PHP's type of the decoded value; canonical_base64 and sha256 are present when the value canonicalises, canonical_error when it does not. An implementation must accept exactly the ok cases and produce exactly these canonical bytes.
